scope: Persistence registration and selected allocation/update routines in installed binaries. In-memory offsets are not wire offsets. Historical schema branches require class metadata version selection. Research only; no vendor loadability or writer completeness is established.
method: Inspect named routines with nm, c++filt and llvm-objdump --dis-symname, record member names/types and evidence addresses without copying binary code. Cached intrinsic type pointers are reused across adjacent registrations. Version branch facts were read from initializer control flow.

semantics.name: ParameterTable.highWaterMark
semantics.description: Unsigned allocation counter, initialized to zero. getNextID preincrements and returns it. It is independent of the number of live parameters. removeParameter does not decrement it.

semantics.name: Parameter.birthday
semantics.description: Expression-engine version captured at construction, not a date or time. Constructor invokes Ns::Expressions::Interface::latestVersion and stores its uint32 result.

semantics.name: DynamicUpdateData.timeStamp
semantics.description: mark invokes std::__1::chrono::system_clock::now and stores its raw returned integer into the registered uint64 field. updateOwnerData and setPredecessorData use these values for predecessor update checks. No universal epoch or unit is claimed across Windows/macOS captures.

semantics.name: MemberSet traversal
semantics.description: addNewMember inserts into std::map<string,Member*,std::less<string>>. visitChildren begins at the tree minimum and advances using in-order successor links. Field names sort lexically and member option flags can affect visits. Wire attribution still requires the selected persistence visitor and class schema version.

runtimeSource.note: Loaded runtime metadata dump supplied by parent agent; includes current member names and versions, not member wire types.

entityFraming.importantCorrection: The common first four zero payload bytes are an empty root-id string length, not a schema version. An ordinary no-subject, no-name-value-pair payload has a six-byte entity prefix before class members. Schema version belongs to the metadata class entry. The undo/redo path serializes EntityObservers instead of EntitySubjects.

entitySubjects.importantCorrection: The four-byte number after a subject reference is the observer index, not a feature argument slot. The array is obtained from the referenced entity; the writer locates its own observer interface. Null/unavailable observer cases can emit -1. Cloning has additional branch-specific flags not described by the ordinary archive profile.
